headline: I looked away for one second
body: and the newborn cry was gone. The small one — the one that sounded like a kitten in a shoebox.
I looked away and she started answering me. Not words. Just sound. Just her, deciding to talk back.

I looked away and the little grunt she made falling asleep on my chest stopped happening,
_and I never got to hear the last one._
Everyone warned me she'd grow out of the clothes.
*Nobody warned me she'd grow out of the sounds.*
